issue.body: I attempted to review the related stuff and haven't found any other options not being compiled. Though - feel free to suggest any additional areas to be reviewed. Fixes #611

body: Great Volodya! In reviewing options, you need to check if the option is ever actually used. In the case of --teamcity you would see the value being tested and acted on. For others, it would be "acted on" by changing a setting that is passed to the framework. If it sets a flag and that flag is never used, then it should not be a valid entry because it confuses people.
